record.question: Under CCS (Leave) Rules, a government servant applies for earned leave, but the authority considers half pay leave more appropriate. Which of the following is the correct position?
options: The authority may sanction half pay leave if earned leave is administratively inconvenient.
The authority may alter the kind of leave if the government servant has sufficient half pay leave.
The authority cannot alter the kind of leave due and applied for except at the written request of the Government servant.
The authority may convert earned leave into any other leave after recording reasons in writing.
